title: So Soft!
text: So Soft!. My husband recently installed hardwood flooring in our bedroom. I ordered this rug to go on the floor right next to my side of the bed. It's so soft! I have been enjoying how it feels when I first step on it when getting out of bed. It does tend to slide around easily, so we're going to get a carpet pad for it to help it stay in place. Overall, I am very happy with it.
